user.title: FusionSolar charger
user.description: Use your owner login for the FusionSolar web portal. The subdomain is the first part of your portal address (e.g. uni004eu5 in uni004eu5.fusionsolar.huawei.com). The charger ID is the dnId from the charge record request.

reauth_confirm.title: FusionSolar login needs attention
reauth_confirm.description: FusionSolar rejected the saved login. Enter your current username and password. Saved sessions stay available meanwhile.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check username, password and subdomain.
error.captcha: FusionSolar asks for a captcha. Log in once in a browser, then try again later.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one charger can be configured.
